children.name: Augment insights
mPulse RUM
children.comments: Collect and analyze real-user data to monitor the performance of your website.

children.name: Log delivery
children.comments: Specify the level of detail you want to be logged in your Log Delivery Service reports. Log User-Agent Header to obtain detailed information in the Traffic by Browser and OS report.
Control the settings related to monitoring and reporting. This gives you additional visibility into your traffic and audiences.

children.name: Accelerate delivery
Origin connectivity
children.comments: Optimize the connection between edge and origin.

children.name: Protocol optimizations
children.comments: Serve your website using modern and fast protocols.

children.name: Prefetching
Prefetching objects
Bots
children.comments: Disable prefetching for specific clients identifying themselves as bots and crawlers. This avoids requesting unnecessary resources from the origin.
Define for which HTML pages prefetching should be enabled.

children.name: Prefetchable objects
children.comments: Define which resources should be prefetched.
Instruct edge servers to retrieve embedded resources before the browser requests them.

children.name: Adaptive acceleration
children.comments: Automatically and continuously apply performance optimizations to your website using machine learning.
Control the settings related to improving the performance of delivering objects to your users.

children.name: Offload origin
CSS and JavaScript
children.comments: Override the default caching behavior for CSS and JavaScript

children.name: Fonts
children.comments: Override the default caching behavior for fonts.

children.name: Images
children.comments: Override the default caching behavior for images.

children.name: Image and Video Manager (Images)
children.comments: Enable Scale for Mobile to serve the best available size for the requesting device. (Careful testing is highly recommended.) Enable Use Best File Type to serve the image format that works best for the requesting client. To configure breakpoint widths, derivative image quality, and artistic transformations, save and activate this configuration; then, create policies for this policy set via either Image and Video Manager Policy Manager or the OPEN Image and Video Manager API.

children.name: HTML pages
children.comments: Override the default caching behavior for HTML pages cached on edge servers.

children.name: Redirects
children.comments: Configure caching for HTTP redirects. The redirect is cached for the same TTL as a 200 HTTP response when this feature is enabled.

children.name: POST responses
children.comments: Define when HTTP POST requests should be cached. You should enable it under a criteria match.

children.name: Uncacheable objects
children.comments: Configure the default client caching behavior for uncacheable content at the edge.

Control the settings related to caching content at the edge and in the browser. As a result, fewer requests go to your origin, fewer bytes leave your data centers, and your assets are closer to your users.

children.name: Strengthen security
Allowed methods
POST
children.comments: Allow use of the POST HTTP request method.

children.name: OPTIONS
children.comments: Allow use of the OPTIONS HTTP request method.

children.name: PUT
children.comments: Allow use of the PUT HTTP request method.

children.name: DELETE
children.comments: Allow use of the DELETE HTTP request method.

children.name: PATCH
children.comments: Allow use of the PATCH HTTP request method.
Allow the use of HTTP methods. Consider enabling additional methods under a path match for increased origin security.

children.name: Obfuscate debug info
children.comments: Do not expose back-end information unless the request contains the Pragma debug header.

children.name: Obfuscate backend info
children.comments: Do not expose back-end information unless the request contains an additional secret header. Regularly change the criteria to use a specific unique value for the secret header.
Control the settings that minimize the information your website shares with clients and malicious entities to reduce your exposure to threats.

children.name: Increase availability
Site failover
children.comments: Specify how edge servers respond when the origin is not available.

children.name: Origin health
children.comments: Monitor the health of your origin by tracking unsuccessful IP connection attempts.
Control how to respond when your origin or third parties are slow or even down to minimize the negative impact on user experience.

children.name: Minimize payload
Compressible objects
children.comments: Serve gzip compressed content for text-based formats.
Control the settings that reduce the size of the delivered content and decrease the number of bytes sent by your properties. This allows you to cut down the network overhead of your website or API.

children.name: Redirect to HTTPS
children.comments: Redirect to the same URL on HTTPS protocol, issuing a 301 response code (Moved Permanently). You may change the response code to 302 if needed.

warnings.detail: If you are changing your `Origin Server` SSL Certificate Verification settings it is strongly recommended that you test on Staging before activating on Production. Failure to test on Staging may result in a service outage.

Enabling cookie logging can lead to instances of PII or other PCI data being saved to logs in plain text. We do not recommend saving all cookies, however you may still add selected cookies you determine to be safe to save.

HTTP/3 connection reuse lets clients re-use an open connection for any domain included in your certificate, even if these domains point to different origins. Most browsers will perform a DNS query to ensure there's an overlap in the domain's IP before reusing the connection. If you're using multiple certificates, specifically both Standard TLS and Enhanced TLS, don't include the same domain across them. If you do, an HTTP request to the domain that requires Enhanced TLS could be resolved using the less secure Standard TLS certificate, and vice-versa.
